title: Radial retraction of a face from its centre: gauge bounds, boundary values, radial estimate (parent steps 1 and 3)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and a ∈ ℝ^P with |a_i − 1/2| < 1/4 for all i. Let b ∈ ℤ^P and J a nonempty set of coordinate indices, F := F(b, J) = {y : b_k ≤ y_k ≤ b_k + 1 (k ∈ J), y_k = b_k (k ∉ J)}. For y ∈ ℝ^P let N(y) := max_{k ∈ J} max((y_k − b_k − a_k)/(1 − a_k), (b_k + a_k − y_k)/a_k). This is the gauge of F − a_F at y − a_F, where a_F has coordinates b_k + a_k on J and b_k off J. Let ψ_F : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be any map with ψ_F(y)_i = b_i + a_i + (y_i − b_i − a_i)/N(y) for i ∈ J and ψ_F(y)_i = y_i for i ∉ J. Let x ∈ F with x_i ≠ b_i + a_i for some i ∈ J. Then: (1) |x_k − b_k − a_k| ≤ N(x) for all k ∈ J; (2) 0 < N(x) ≤ 1; (3) ψ_F(x) ∈ F; (4) ψ_F(x)_i ∈ {b_i, b_i + 1} for some i ∈ J; (5) if x_i ∈ {b_i, b_i + 1} for some i ∈ J, then ψ_F(x) = x; (6) for every y ∈ F with y_i ≠ b_i + a_i for some i ∈ J, |ψ_F(y) − ψ_F(x)| ≤ (1 + 4√|J|)/N(x) · |y − x|. Division by 0 is read as 0 (as in Lean). N(y) = 0 exactly when y_k = b_k + a_k for all k ∈ J (on F, only at the centre a_F); no conclusion uses ψ_F at such points.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (a : Euclid P), (∀ i, |a i - 1 / 2| < 1 / 4) → ∀ (b : Fin P → ℤ) (J : Finset (Fin P)) (hJ : J.Nonempty) (ψF : Euclid P → Euclid P), (∀ y : Euclid P, ∀ i, ψF y i = if i ∈ J then (b i : ℝ) + a i + (y i - b i - a i) / J.sup' hJ (fun k => max ((y k - b k - a k) / (1 - a k)) ((b k + a k - y k) / a k)) else y i) → ∀ x : Euclid P, (∀ i, (i ∈ J → (b i : ℝ) ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ b i + 1) ∧ (i ∉ J → x i = b i)) → (∃ i ∈ J, x i ≠ b i + a i) → (∀ k ∈ J, |x k - b k - a k| ≤ J.sup' hJ (fun k => max ((x k - b k - a k) / (1 - a k)) ((b k + a k - x k) / a k))) ∧ 0 < J.sup' hJ (fun k => max ((x k - b k - a k) / (1 - a k)) ((b k + a k - x k) / a k)) ∧ J.sup' hJ (fun k => max ((x k - b k - a k) / (1 - a k)) ((b k + a k - x k) / a k)) ≤ 1 ∧ (∀ i, (i ∈ J → (b i : ℝ) ≤ ψF x i ∧ ψF x i ≤ b i + 1) ∧ (i ∉ J → ψF x i = b i)) ∧ (∃ i ∈ J, ψF x i = b i ∨ ψF x i = b i + 1) ∧ ((∃ i ∈ J, x i = b i ∨ x i = b i + 1) → ψF x = x) ∧ ∀ y : Euclid P, (∀ i, (i ∈ J → (b i : ℝ) ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ b i + 1) ∧ (i ∉ J → y i = b i)) → (∃ i ∈ J, y i ≠ b i + a i) → dist (ψF y) (ψF x) ≤ (1 + 4 * Real.sqrt J.card) / J.sup' hJ (fun k => max ((x k - b k - a k) / (1 - a k)) ((b k + a k - x k) / a k)) * dist y x
